scoring: 0 unrelated, 1 adjacent without verified reusable artifact, 2 plausible reusable artifact with source evidence, 3 specific technically compatible and decision-ready
review_method: Same assistant read original primary GitHub issue/PR bodies and public issue comments of each selected source and both paired targets. Selection was committed before the primary-source review. No independent or blinded judge. Candidate ranking was previously tuned on this cohort; these labels must not be used as a held-out generalization claim.

facts: MoE sanity baseline on JUPITER/LUMI uses GPT-NeoX 20B tokenizer, 50k vocabulary
Issue comments ask to close the work; source remains open

technical.reason: A 2022 merged change selecting CLIP model tokenizers does not answer a 2025/2026 MoE training baseline on GPT-NeoX vocabulary. Shared word 'tokenizer' is not a reusable solution.

fulltext.reason: A CLIP WebDataset distributed-evaluation nodesplitter crash fix does not address the source MoE training baseline.

cases.lowest_effort_note: The original task already has a closure request; check whether it remains necessary before proposing new infrastructure.

facts: Issue asks to adapt warc2text for opt-out handling
Its own comments link Swiss-AI/Apertus retroactive robots.txt filtering and existing public source code

technical.reason: De-chunking ArchiveBot HTTP responses, completed via bitextor/warc2text PR #76, is not retroactive website opt-out recognition.

fulltext.reason: The release planning discussion includes robots.txt opt-out filtering; the topic overlaps the source work, but that downstream filtering stage is not proven a compatible warc2text implementation or missing collaboration.

cases.lowest_effort_note: Source discussion already points to the Swiss-AI/Apertus preprocessing references. Do not contact maintainers to repeat that advice.

facts: Audio/video MIME extraction is planned as a warc2text extension
Source comments report little useful audio in 2025/2026 crawls, most useful finds in 2018/2019
Contributors already discuss a mixed-crawl trial and LUMI-O storage constraints; developer estimated 3–5 days for the change

technical.reason: ArchiveBot de-chunking is no demonstrated solution for MIME routing, audio usefulness or crawl-sampling economics.

fulltext.reason: HPLT storage and 2025 CC processing are related operational context, but the completed HPLT 3.1 storage issue provides no direct media extraction implementation.

cases.lowest_effort_note: The current team already plans a small multi-crawl trial; any independent recommendation should test representativeness and expected useful-audio yield before committing larger reprocessing. No extra outreach.

summary.interpretation: In this small, knowingly source-tuned and single-reviewer set, both approaches failed to produce any actionable cross-project handoff; technical-vocabulary ranking was not better and had lower topical relevance. The full-text's two 'adjacent' matches are not established useful solutions.

limitations: Only three chosen source anchors, non-blinded single reviewer
Original matcher rules were tuned on observed corpus, not a true holdout
No source body hash pinned by Git commit upstream; URLs/dated descriptions used
Neither method sees all of source comments in its initial index; reviewer had equal comment-source access
No measurement of search time, independent decision accuracy, adoption or saved GPU hours
No automatic external comments or actions
